description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different methods in detecting misinformation, with the vertical axis representing accuracy in percentage and the horizontal axis listing various conditions. The chart is divided into two main sections, each representing a different method: "Ours" and "w/o." Within each method, there are five conditions compared: "Ours," "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," and "w/o emotion." The "Ours" method shows the highest accuracy across all conditions, with the highest accuracy being 90.57% for "Ours" and the lowest being 83.02% for "w/o text." The "w/o" method shows a range of accuracies, with the highest being 89.62% for "w/o emotion" and the lowest being 84.91% for "w/o select." The bars are color-coded, with "Ours" in red and "w/o" in blue, and the values are indicated at the top of each bar. The chart does not include any additional annotations or emphasis on specific bars.
